about: Hosts from which live.promptugal.news may embed an operator's own player. A camera is embedded only when data.promptugal.news's register says embedding is allowed, its terms say so, and its embed URL's host is listed here. live.b@PrompTugal.dinis adds a host by hand after reading that operator's terms; each entry names the operator, the terms URL and the date read. Empty means every camera is a link out.
